text:
Maya: Quick idea — we need a 1-pager that sharpens Redwood vs cloud infra + LLM APIs for the webinar next Tue. Focus: predictable latency, cost levers, and failover story.
Owen: thumbs up. Can we surface a couple of real numbers? e.g., tokens/sec vs managed endpoints, and cost per 1M tokens rough.
Priya: I can pull bench numbers. Will have an initial table by EOD — prioritize latency tail (p99) and e2e request cost.
Liam: Also: include routing/fallback graphic. Customers ask if 'managed = simpler'. We need sharp rebuttals.
Sara: +1. For messaging, lean into 'predictable economics' and 'unified runtime' — two-line hooks for slide headers.
Maya: sample hooks: "Predictable latency, predictable spend" and "One API for hosted, dedicated, private" — keep short.
Owen: For the webinar demo: run same prompt on Redwood-hosted vs a major cloud LLM endpoint and show latency variance. @Priya can you set up the test harness?
Priya: Will do. Plan: 5 runs x 1000 requests, measure p50/p95/p99, token mix short/medium/long. Using stable-llama-13b on both.
QAbot: benchmark-complete: https://ci.redwood.internal/artifacts/bench-494321 — raw CSV uploaded.
Liam: Nice. Can marketing get a condensed chart (latency violin + cost bars) for slides? @Sara
Sara: yes, I'll make 2 visuals: one for latency distribution, one for cost-per-1k and cost-per-1M.
Maya: Need rebut lines for sales: 3 fast responses vs each competitor claim.
Owen: Competitor claims we should counter: "fully managed simplicity", "lower sticker price", "broad model catalog" — have canned replies.
Priya: Draft replies:
- "Fully managed" -> "Yes, if you don't need predictable SLOs. Redwood adds reserved capacity + fallbacks for production." 
- "Lower sticker" -> "We show unit economics with batching + caching — lower per-token cost at scale." 
- "Model catalog" -> "Our catalog + model profiles = verified perf + cost guidance. Not just access."
Maya: Good. Keep them <2 sentences each.
Owen: Also include quick objection-handlers for procurement on contracts and SLAs.
Sara: I'll add 2 bullets: SLA options and private deployment (VPC/HSM) callouts.
Priya: ETA EOD for raw numbers, Mia (design) will turn them into visuals tomorrow morning.
Maya: Action list:
- Priya: bench CSV + winner chart (EOD)
- Sara: slide visuals + rebut bullets (tomorrow 11am)
- Owen: script for demo + runbook (tomorrow 10am)
- Liam: sales cheat-sheet 1-page (tomorrow noon)
- Maya: finalize webinar outline & posting copy (today 5pm)
Owen: FYI: could we include a short pre-webinar blog post with benchmark highlights? Quick 300-400 words.
Maya: yes — draft in #content-drafts. I'll ping when slide deck is ready.
Sara: :party: great sprint. 
Priya: uploading final CSV now.
QAbot: deploy-notice: webinar landing page live at https://redwood.ai/webinar/inference-playbook
Maya: solid. closing — will post final thread when slides and blog draft are ready. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
